title: ModelX evaluation on frozen 400-drawing Quick, Draw! set

preprocessing.canvas: Same generated canvas per test drawing used by the existing paired evaluation (1200x720, 28x28 bitmap alpha-rendered at 364px centered)
preprocessing.pipeline: SketchAI preprocessFor333Model: bounding-box crop with padding 1.186, area-averaged to 96x96, contrast normalization target peak 1.0, min gamma 0.25
preprocessing.channel_adaptation: Replicated resulting white-on-black grayscale channel identically to RGB to satisfy observed model input shape (96,96,3)
preprocessing.normalization_note: Training input normalization and color preprocessing were not included with the model archive; this app-style preprocessing is provisional.

limitations: The supplied output class-index map has 333 unique contiguous indices and all 40 tested labels are present, but alignment with the model learned output neurons is not independently verified.
Model archive does not provide training-data provenance; overlap with the held-out evaluation drawings is unknown.

ModelX expects 96x96x3, whereas existing 333 profile in the app was designed around a 96x96x1 model. This evaluation adapted grayscale to RGB by channel replication; train-time color/channel semantics are undocumented.
Same 400 images and labels as existing model comparison, but model-specific input preprocessing differs and ModelX required a provisional channel adaptation.

diagnostic_not_primary.input: black ink on white; inverted app-style grayscale values replicated across RGB channels; float 0..1

preprocessing_sensitivity.interpretation: Color polarity is undocumented and materially changes predictions. The primary metric remains the stated white-ink-on-black app-style pipeline; neither convention is authenticated as training-time preprocessing.

direct_96x96_resize_experiment.status: exploratory only; same 400 manifest records; not part of primary app-style result
direct_96x96_resize_experiment.source_pixels: original Quick, Draw! 28x28 bitmap values scaled directly to 96x96; source contains no additional resolution detail
direct_96x96_resize_experiment.channels: grayscale replicated to RGB to match ModelX input signature
direct_96x96_resize_experiment.interpretation: Observed accuracy changes materially with polarity and resize filter. Since variants were compared on this fixed test set and training preprocessing is unknown, do not select the production pipeline from the best observed variant.
